missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Пёс' is an animate masculine noun in the nominative as the subject of 'залаял'. 'Большой' agrees in the masculine nominative.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative with fleeting vowel. 'Пса' is the accusative object of 'кормит', and as an animate masculine noun it copies the genitive. The vowel ё drops out in oblique cases.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Пса' is the genitive form after 'нет', with the fleeting ё dropped. The phrase states that the neighbour has no dog.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Псу' is the dative form marking the recipient of 'дала'. The fleeting ё drops out, leaving the bare stem.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Псом' takes the instrumental after 'с', with the fleeting vowel dropped. 'Пёстрым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Псе' is the prepositional form after 'о', with the fleeting ё dropped. It names what the children care for.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Пса' takes the genitive after 'без', with the vowel dropped, expressing that life is dull without a dog.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Псы' is the nominative plural subject of 'бегают'. The fleeting ё disappears in the plural, and 'большие' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. After 'двух' the animate noun takes the genitive plural 'псов', which also serves as the accusative object of 'взял'.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Пёс' is the nominative subject, here keeping the fleeting ё in its base form. 'Верный' is the agreeing masculine adjective describing loyalty.
